warnings.message: We detected that this HGVS could be represented with a more 3' location. Technically this does not conform to the HGVS standard. (See for example https://varnomen.hgvs.org/bg-material/numbering/) We do not require this for our processing so we ignored it. Note: we have not implemented the exon/exon exception to the 3' rule, so this warning could be in error.
